policies: Disclaimer: Our top priority is always your safety on the river. While we make every effort to operate tours as advertised, equipment, vessels, staffing, departure times, and schedules may change without prior notice due to mechanical issues, weather, river conditions, or other safety-related factors. To ensure a safe and enjoyable experience, substitutions or schedule adjustments may be necessary. In some cases, tours may not depart at the exact scheduled time due to changing river conditions. If any changes are required, we will notify you as early as reasonably practicable. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a private 2-hour cruise along the scenic Willamette River to the majestic Willamette Falls, one of the largest waterfalls in the Northwestern US. Relax as your captain shares fascinating stories and local history while you take in stunning waterfront views. Perfect for families, couples, or corporate groups of up to six guests.
